mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be plain water, which contains no digestible carbohydrate and has no meaningful glycemic impact on blood sugar levels, including for someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole grain or high-fiber alternatives instead only when replacing sweetened beverages or refined-carbohydrate drinks; plain water itself is an appropriate choice.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A small glass of plain drinking water with no visible added ingredients, sweeteners, or flavorings.
